name: Λιανή Άμμος Χαλκίδας
evidence: Sources describe Liani Ammos as not organized, relatively secluded, frequented by kite surfers; note some results conflate with the North-Evia Liani Ammos but both are described as unorganized.

name: Μακρύς Γιαλός
evidence: Described as a secluded campers' paradise with a municipal camping in the plane-tree forest; no explicit sunbed/bar statement for the Evia beach (heavy name collision with Kefalonia/Crete/Zakynthos).

name: Μνήματα
evidence: Karystos guide: 'Παραλία Μνήματα (8.6 Km από Κάρυστο)... ομπρέλες – ξαπλώστρες της καντίνας και εύκολη πρόσβαση' — canteen provides umbrellas and sunbeds.

name: Παραλία Αγίου Νικολάου
evidence: Multiple Agios Nikolaos beaches on Evia (Aidipsos, Ellinika); the Aidipsos one is described as not organized (bring your own umbrella) though summer beach bars operate — cannot confirm which is ours.

name: Παραλία Αχλαδίου (Φραγκάκη)
evidence: 'Υπάρχει οργανωμένο τμήμα με ομπρέλες, ξαπλώστρες και service από 2-3 επιχειρήσεις' plus showers per the official bathing-water profile; cafeterias and fish tavernas on the beach.

name: Παραλία Βλαχιάς
evidence: Vlachia-area beaches described as natural and less developed, but no explicit statement about sunbeds/bar for the village beach itself.

name: Παραλία Γιάλτρων
evidence: One source says the sandier left side of the Loutra Gialtron harbour beach is 'πιο οργανωμένη', but no explicit sunbed/umbrella evidence and possible confusion with nearby Mpania Gialtron.

name: Παραλία Δάφνης
evidence: Conflicting sources — one claims organized with sunbeds/umbrellas, others say not organized; also two Dafni beaches on Evia (Nerotrivia and Chiliadou area), identity not certain.

name: Παραλία Καλλιανού
evidence: 'Ομπρέλες και ξαπλώστρες δεν υπάρχουν στην παραλία Καλλιανού... δε διαθέτει beach bar' — explicitly unorganized, exposed to winds.

name: Παραλία Κρύας Βρύσης
evidence: North-Evia (Agia Anna extension) Krya Vrysi is described as 'οργανωμένη με ομπρέλες και ξαπλώστρες' with a shop on the beach serving coffee/ouzo; note there is also a Krya Vrysi near Karystos.

name: Παραλία Πολιτικών
evidence: Official bathing-water profile: part of the 3.5km Politika beach is organized with 'ξαπλώστρες και ομπρέλες, ντους, καλάθια και κάδους απορριμμάτων'; there is also a free section.

name: Παραλία Φάρου
evidence: Official bathing-water profile for Faros Avlidas: 'Τμήμα της παραλίας είναι οργανωμένο και διαθέτει... ξαπλώστρες και ομπρέλες' — assuming our Paralia Farou is the Avlida one (lighthouse at NE end).

name: Πόρτο Λάφια
evidence: Sources mention only a canteen and a taverna; grand plans for an organized beach were never realized — no sunbed/umbrella evidence, but no explicit 'unorganized' statement either.

name: Ροδιές
evidence: Search results only returned Rovies (Ροβιές) beach, a likely name collision — no evidence found for a beach named Ροδιές on Evia.

name: Σουβάλα
evidence: Results dominated by Souvala on Aegina (organized with beach bar); could not find evidence clearly about Souvala Chalkidas/Evia — collision, no accept.

name: Στενή
evidence: Results refer to the mountain village Steni Dirfyos; no beach-specific organization evidence found.

name: Σχοινοδαύλεια
evidence: Described everywhere as an 'unknown', remote exotic beach (gorge, pond, stalactites) with no facilities mentioned — consistent with unorganized but no explicit statement.

name: Τσοκαΐτι
evidence: eviagreece: Tsokaiti (Istiaia) has 'organized areas with loungers'; in earlier years canteens and beach bars provided loungers and umbrellas — present-tense sunbeds claimed, bar status uncertain.

name: Αχερούνες
evidence: 'Η παραλία είναι οργανωμένη με ομπρέλες και ξαπλώστρες, ενώ διαθέτει ντους και ράμπα ΑμΕΑ'; cafeterias along the beach.

name: Πετρίτσα
evidence: One of Skyros' most deserted beaches — no tavernas or cafeterias, not organized with umbrellas/sunbeds (has showers/changing rooms/WC only), ideal for free camping.

name: Άγιος Πέτρος
evidence: Explicitly 'ανοργάνωτη παραλία' — not organized, shade only from the pines behind the beach; free camping in the pine forest.

name: Γιάννακης
evidence: Small beach at Pera Panta near Itea/Galaxidi; no source states whether it has sunbeds or a bar.

name: Μονιά
evidence: No evidence found specifically for Monia beach; results describe the different Monastiraki (Dorida) organized beach — collision, not accepted.

name: Παραλία Αγίου Μηνά
evidence: Conflicting: one guide says 'δεν θα βρεις beach bar ή ομπρέλες, έλα οργανωμένος', another says a canteen «Ο ΑΓΙΟΣ» offers everything 'από νερό μέχρι ξαπλώστρα' — seasonal/uncertain.

name: Άι Γιάννης
evidence: An 'organized beach of Agios Ioannis' near Alykes and an 'Agios Ioannis beach bar renting sunbeds' near Theologos both appear, but cannot confirm which (if either) is this record.

name: Κέδρος
evidence: Results conflate with Kedros on Donousa; no reliable evidence for the Fthiotida Kedros beach.

name: Παραλία Αγίου Γεωργίου Πελασγίας
evidence: No beach-specific evidence found; all results were name collisions (Naxos, Corfu, Crete).

name: Παραλία Βουγιουκλάκη
evidence: Theologos guide: the beach 'does not have facilities with sunbeds and umbrellas, visitors are advised to bring their own'; Theologos beaches are primarily unorganized.

name: Σχοινιά
evidence: Results dominated by Schinias Attica; one mention that the Livanates/Schinia area of Fthiotida has 'no sunbeds, umbrellas or beach bar' but it referred to nearby Kalamia — not accepted as direct evidence.

name: Άγιος Νικόλαος
evidence: Viotia beach guide: Agios Nikolaos has a large sandy beach where 'all day bar restaurants have set up umbrellas and loungers on the beach' with showers and food; reservation needed on August weekends.

name: Λαιμός
evidence: WonderGreece has a Laimos (Viotia) beach page but no organization details surfaced; other results were Vouliagmeni collisions.

name: Agios Nikolaos
evidence: Sources describe organized beaches NEAR Agios Nikolaos Sithonia (Trani Ammouda, hotel beaches) but nothing explicit for a beach named Agios Nikolaos itself.

name: Babylon
evidence: 'Babylon Beach is partially organized, with sunbeds and umbrellas available for a fee at the beach bar'; single on-site beach bar serves coffee, refreshments and snacks (near Olympiada).

name: Megali Ammos
evidence: Megali Ammos (Ammouliani, Halkidiki): 'partially organized, featuring sunbeds and umbrellas, complemented by a tavern and a beach bar' — sunbeds via two beach bars (15€/set 2024 or free with order).

name: Sykia
evidence: Sykia beach (Sithonia) is 'partly organized, offering sunbeds, umbrellas, a few beach bars' — sunbeds free for beach-bar clients; large sections remain wild/free.

name: Συκιά Ολυμπιάδας
evidence: gr-beaches states Sykia (Olympiada) 'δεν έχει beach bar'; pine-crowned Blue Flag beach described without organized facilities — some results conflate with Sykia Sithonia, so held at medium.

name: Πλαζ Αρετσούς
evidence: Aretsou is 'η μοναδική οργανωμένη παραλία εντός του αστικού ιστού' — free umbrellas and sunbeds, municipal refreshment stand, showers and WC (note: swimming officially discouraged per water profile).

name: Παραλία Σερραϊκή Ακτή
evidence: Serraiki Akti (Asprovalta–Nea Kerdylia strip) is 'organized in sections with sun loungers and permanent umbrellas, changing rooms, WC, showers' and has beach bars, plus free space.
